Core Connect Wallet modal now opens from header and lobby across responsive widths, but wallet-option deep paths still fail (runtime crash on option click; WalletConnect QR path not rendered). Backend SIWE mainnet/origin/replay/session guards passed with real signed challenge using disposable wallet.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Core modal open bug is fixed (header/lobby, repeated open/close, Escape no settings jump, responsive widths good). Remaining blocker is deep connector action causing runtime crash and missing WalletConnect QR step visibility. Re-run browser test specifically on connector-option click and inspect frontend bundle stack for invalid border prop source.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: /loadout -> Connect Wallet -> click WalletConnect (or MetaMask path after reopen) -> runtime overlay appears with 'invalid border=0' and React root error. This indicates a rendering/runtime incompatibility in connector-option path (likely downstream wallet modal content) rather than the initial modal opener. Mitigation: inspect built bundle stack frame around reported location and component rendering border attribute; then rerun connector deep-path e2e.
